upstream.provenance_requirement: The adapter must be constructed with a trusted trace-completion verifier. The verifier returns the canonical command emitted by the resolved Tide Trace state machine; the submitted command must match it field-for-field. FakeAuthority is a test fixture only.

nonnegative_safe_integer_fields.rule: Each value must be an exact integer in this inclusive range; fractions, NaN, infinities, negatives, and values above the JavaScript safe-integer maximum are rejected before the verifier.

input_contract.rejection_rule: Unknown, missing, wrong-typed, metatable-backed, or fixed-value-mismatched fields fail closed before the verifier is called.

security_boundary: This adapter does not make raw actor_id or lifecycle_id an owner. Downstream economy-v2 core resolves the stable owner from actor_id, lifecycle_id, and authority_proof_ref.

downstream_authority_attestation.canonical_digest_projection: The Node boundary hashes all copied canonical fields except authority_proof_ref. authority_proof_ref is separately reverified on every attempt so a valid rotated proof may replay without becoming a new economic identity.
downstream_authority_attestation.attestation_ref_stability_rule: tide_trace_attestation_ref is a stable reference for one identical canonical Tide evidence projection and must not encode or rotate with authority_proof_ref. If a resolver changes it, the request conflicts rather than replaying the prior terminal receipt.
downstream_authority_attestation.receipt_binding: The resolver attestation is copied into the offline request fingerprint and offline award plan. Because award_plan_hash is an economy-v2 identity-fingerprint input, changed canonical source evidence conflicts rather than replaying.
